look.why: An icy polar-cyan pastel that frames the snow-white winter coat cleanly without washing it out.

size.measure: nose to tail tip, about 0.85 m (body 46–68 cm plus 25–35 cm bushy tail per ADW)

habitat.text: Treeless Arctic tundra, coastal pack ice and alpine fell across North America, Greenland, Iceland and Eurasia.

diet.text: Lemmings, voles, seabirds, eggs, berries, carrion and leftovers from polar bear kills on sea ice.

facts.text: Its coat changes color with the seasons—pure snow-white in winter and charcoal-brown in summer.
It can endure temperatures down to −70 °C without shivering thanks to the warmest fur of any mammal.

id.habitat: Tundra Arktik tanpa pohon, es laut pesisir, dan pegunungan alpen di Amerika Utara, Greenland, Islandia, dan Eurasia.
id.diet: Lemming, tikus padang, burung laut, telur, buah beri, dan sisa buruan beruang kutub di atas es laut.
facts: Bulunya berubah warna mengikuti musim—putih seputih salju di musim dingin dan cokelat arang di musim panas.
Mampu bertahan pada suhu hingga −70 °C tanpa menggigil berkat bulu terhangat di antara semua mamalia.
